game.name: UltraCombo
game.desc: Native ARM64 / OpenGL ES 2.0 port of UltraCombo, running Killer Instinct (1994) and Killer Instinct 2 (1996) via static MIPS R4600 and ADSP-2105 recompilation. Bring your own MAME ROMs and CHD disk images.
game.developer: Rare / Midway (Engine: thefixinhixon, ARM64 Port: KillerArm)
